redesign.label: Redesign
redesign.description: Revise one task design from the current template and author notes.

commit-desing.label: Commit design
commit-desing.description: Record approval of the exact design and template contents.

implement.label: Implementation + oracle
implement.description: Implement one approved task and repair its oracle until it passes.

commit-impl.label: Commit implementation
commit-impl.description: Record approval of the successful implementation and its passing oracle.

local_bench.label: Local benchmark
local_bench.description: Run Codimango trials and retain their measured results.

local_bench_analyze.label: Local benchmark analysis
local_bench_analyze.description: Analyze all saved trials from the current local benchmark.

export_to_codimango.label: Export to Codimango
export_to_codimango.description: Copy the implemented task into Cyber Bench, commit it, and push to main.

custom.label: Custom command
custom.description: Apply an explicit agent prompt to one selected task.

troubleshoot.label: Troubleshoot
troubleshoot.description: Diagnose a supplied Codimango evidence snapshot without remote mutations.
